results.title: TC-GEO-1268-001 - Sort by Sentiment orders concepts Positive, then Mixed, then Negative with no score shown

steps.title: Given the user is on the Overview of brand analysis B
steps.expected: The Top Concepts list is displayed with its sort menu
steps.observed: B = Toyota (439acd96), Overview, default filters (Oct 14 - 20, 2026, All Countries, ChatGPT+Gemini+Perplexity). Card "Top Topics Associated with Your Brand" > "All Topics" with sort button "Sort by Frequency" (default) and pills All (31) / Positive (28) / Mixed (1) / Negative (2). 31 rows.

steps.title: When the user opens the sort menu
steps.expected: The menu lists "Frequency", "Sentiment" and "A–Z", and no score entry
steps.observed: Menu has exactly 3 entries: "Sort by Frequency", "Sort by Sentiment", "Sort A-Z" (ASCII hyphen U+002D, not en dash). No score entry; no signed number in the menu.

steps.title: And the user selects Sentiment
steps.expected: The list is re-ordered
steps.observed: Button now reads "Sort by Sentiment"; order changed (e.g. "prix élevé" Mixed 6% moved from position 14 to 29, "bruit à l'accélération" Negative from 11 to 30).

steps.title: Then the Positive concepts come first, then the Mixed ones, then the Negative ones
steps.expected: Every "Positive" row is above every "Mixed" row, and every "Mixed" row is above every "Negative" row
steps.observed: Rows 1-28 Positive, row 29 Mixed (prix élevé), rows 30-31 Negative (bruit à l'accélération 7%, service après-vente 2%). No group inversion (automatic check on 31 rows).

steps.title: And no numeric score is exposed
steps.expected: No -100 to +100 value and no "{score} sentiment" text (e.g. "-80 sentiment", "+80 sentiment") is shown on the rows or in the sort menu
steps.observed: Card and sort menu scanned: 0 "{n} sentiment" text, 0 signed number. Rows show only "{n} sources • {Label}" and the frequency %.

results.notes: Menu labels are "Sort by Frequency" / "Sort by Sentiment" / "Sort A-Z" (CSV writes "Frequency", "Sentiment", "A–Z" with an en dash) - same three entries, wording-only difference (CSV change proposed). The API top-concepts response still carries sentimentScore per topic (not shown in the UI; backend out of scope). A3 (reversal) checked in TC-002.

results.title: TC-GEO-1268-002 - Inside a polarity group concepts are ordered by frequency, then A–Z

steps.title: Given the user is on the Overview of brand analysis B sorted by Sentiment
steps.expected: The concepts are grouped Positive, Mixed, Negative
steps.observed: Toyota Overview (default filters), Sort by Sentiment: 28 Positive, then 1 Mixed, then 2 Negative.

steps.title: When the user reads the frequency % inside the Positive group
steps.expected: The frequency % decreases from top to bottom (highest first)

steps.title: And the user reads the frequency % inside the Mixed and the Negative groups
steps.expected: In each group the frequency % decreases from top to bottom
steps.observed: Mixed: prix élevé 6% (single row). Negative: bruit à l'accélération 7%, then service après-vente 2%.

steps.title: Then concepts with the same frequency are ordered by name A→Z
steps.expected: The concept whose name comes first alphabetically is listed first
steps.observed: B-tie found in Toyota Overview: "confort de conduite" and "fiabilité à long terme", both Positive, API frequency 0.17 = 0.17 (UI 17%). Sentiment sort lists "confort de conduite" first (the Frequency sort lists them in the reverse API order: fiabilité à long terme first). Other ties also A→Z: consommation de carburant < fiabilité des véhicules (7%), usage familial < valeur de revente (6%), capacité tout-terrain < coûts d'entretien < gamme de modèles < leadership hybride < liderazgo en el mercado (5%), Coût d'entretien < coût et valeur < popularité SUV (4%), Conduite urbaine < étiquette ECO < rapport qualité-prix < satisfaction client < sécurité (3%), marque préférée des Français < praticité familiale (2%).

results.notes: A3 observations: (1) the Sentiment sort cannot be reversed - selecting "Sort by Sentiment" again keeps Positive -> Mixed -> Negative; the menu offers no direction toggle. (2) The A→Z tie-break is case-insensitive and accent-insensitive ("Conduite urbaine" < "étiquette ECO" < "rapport qualité-prix"; "Coût d'entretien" < "coût et valeur"; "satisfaction" < "sécurité"), consistent with a locale compare. Tie verified on API values (top-concepts frequency given with 2 decimals) - a tie on unrounded values cannot be proven from the UI.

results.title: TC-GEO-1268-003 - With a polarity filter on, the Sentiment sort orders the single group by frequency

steps.title: Given the user is on the Overview of brand analysis B sorted by Sentiment
steps.expected: The concepts are grouped Positive, Mixed, Negative
steps.observed: Toyota Overview (default filters), Sort by Sentiment, All (31) pressed: 28 Positive, 1 Mixed, 2 Negative in that order.

steps.title: When the user selects the Negative filter pill
steps.expected: Only "Negative" concepts are listed
steps.observed: Negative (2) pressed (All released): 2 rows, both "Negative": bruit à l'accélération 7%, service après-vente 2%. Sort stays "Sort by Sentiment".

steps.title: Then the list is ordered by frequency
steps.expected: The frequency % decreases from top to bottom, as with the Frequency sort under the same filter
steps.observed: Negative: 7% then 2% under Sentiment sort; Frequency sort under the same filter gives the same 2 rows in the same order. Extra control with the Positive filter (28 rows): Sentiment and Frequency sorts give the identical frequency % sequence and the same set of rows; they differ only inside ties (Sentiment sort applies A→Z, Frequency sort keeps the API order, e.g. 17%: confort de conduite / fiabilité à long terme swapped).

steps.title: And no numeric score is exposed
steps.expected: No -100 to +100 value and no "{score} sentiment" text (e.g. "-80 sentiment", "+80 sentiment") is shown on any row
steps.observed: 0 "{n} sentiment" text and 0 signed number in the card with the Negative and Positive filters.

results.notes: A2 observations: filter pills are single-select (selecting Positive while Negative is on replaces it; All is released when a polarity is chosen). The distribution tiles above the list ("90% Positive 28 topics" / "3% Mixed 1 topic" / "6% Negative 2 topics") are buttons whose aria-pressed follows the active pill (Negative tile pressed with the Negative pill). Frequency sort has no A→Z tie-break (ties in API order) while Sentiment sort has one - possible PO question, outside the AC wording.

results.title: TC-GEO-1268-005 - Polarity filters list only the concepts of the selected polarity

steps.title: Given the user is on the Overview of brand analysis B
steps.expected: The Positive, Mixed and Negative filter pills are shown above the list with their counts
steps.observed: Toyota Overview (default filters): pills "All (31)" (pressed), "Positive (28)", "Mixed (1)", "Negative (2)" above the list; 31 rows (28 Positive, 1 Mixed, 2 Negative).

steps.title: When the user selects the Positive filter pill
steps.expected: Only "Positive" concepts are listed and their number equals the count of the Positive pill
steps.observed: Positive (28) pressed: 28 rows, all "Positive" (= pill count 28).

steps.title: And the user deselects Positive and selects Mixed
steps.expected: Only "Mixed" concepts are listed and their number equals the count of the Mixed pill
steps.observed: Click on the active Positive pill releases it (All (31) pressed again, 31 rows); then Mixed (1) pressed: 1 row "prix élevé | 12 sources • Mixed | 6%" (= pill count 1).

steps.title: And the user deselects Mixed and selects Negative
steps.expected: Only "Negative" concepts are listed and their number equals the count of the Negative pill
steps.observed: Mixed released, Negative (2) pressed: 2 rows, both "Negative" (bruit à l'accélération 7%, service après-vente 2%) = pill count 2.

steps.title: Then removing the filter restores the full list
steps.expected: All concepts are listed again; their number equals the sum of the three pill counts
steps.observed: Click on the active Negative pill: All (31) pressed again, 31 rows = 28 + 1 + 2.

results.notes: A2 observations: single selection (one polarity at a time; selecting another polarity replaces the current one). A filter is removed either by clicking the active pill again (toggle) or by clicking "All (n)". The three distribution tiles above the list mirror the pill state (aria-pressed). Whether pill counts follow the global filters: see TC-GEO-1268-006 (counts change with period/engines).
